title: Posts

table.caption: Post list
table.empty: No posts yet. Press “Write a post” to start.

editor.conflict: The server copy has changed (you may have this post open in another tab). Reload to get the latest version — unsaved changes here will be lost.
editor.excerptPlaceholder: Leave empty and the backend generates one from the body
editor.archiveDraftBody: The draft moves to “Archived” and leaves your working list. The content and the slug are kept — nothing is deleted permanently.
editor.archiveBody: The post moves to “Archived” and disappears from the public site. The content and the slug are kept — nothing is deleted permanently.

publish.intro: Once published it appears at <path>/blogs/{slug}</path> and in the sitemap right away.

issues.category: No category selected. A post without a category cannot be published.
issues.unsaved: You still have unsaved changes. Save first, otherwise the version that goes live is the old one.
issues.description: No meta description and no excerpt. Google will cut its own snippet from the body, usually a worse one.
issues.cover: No cover image. Links shared on social media will be text only.
issues.slug: The slug is still the default one. Change it before publishing — after publishing, changing the slug becomes a 301 redirect problem.

unsavedChanges: This post has unsaved changes. Leaving now loses what you typed. Leave anyway?

seo.heading: SEO
seo.noDescription: No description yet — Google will cut its own snippet from the body, usually a worse one.
seo.slugFromTitle: Generate a slug from the title
seo.slugChanged: This post is live at <path>/blogs/{slug}</path>. Changing the slug 301-redirects the old URL to the new one — old links keep working, but have a reason to change it.
seo.metaTitlePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the post title
seo.metaDescriptionPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the post excerpt
seo.ogImagePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the cover image
seo.canonicalPlaceholder: Only fill this in when the post is republished from elsewhere
seo.canonicalHint: Leaving this empty is right in almost every case — the canonical points at this post by default.
seo.noindex: Tell Google not to index this post
seo.noindexHint: The post stays public and stays in the sitemap — this only asks search engines to skip it.
seo.charCountOver: {length}/{limit} characters — Google will most likely truncate it
seo.ogEmpty: No image — the share card will be text only

tags.searchPlaceholder: Type to search, press Enter to create a tag
tags.label: Tags

categorySelect.label: Category
categorySelect.none: No categories yet — nothing can be published.
categorySelect.requiredHint: A published post must have a category — take it down first if you want to clear this.
categorySelect.optionalHint: Required to publish; drafts save fine without it.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Each post belongs to exactly one category, and a category is required to publish. Categories appear in the public blog's menu bar — drag rows to change the order shown there.
categories.caption: Category list
categories.reorderFailed: {message} The order has been rolled back.
categories.slugFromName: Generate a slug from the name
categories.slugWarning: Changing the slug makes <path>/blogs/category/{slug}</path> return 404 permanently. No redirect is created — every old link to this category page breaks.
categories.descriptionHint: Shown at the top of the category page. This is what keeps that page from reading as thin content to Google — write a real sentence.
categories.deleteBody: Only categories with no posts can be deleted. Posts cannot be published without a category, so move the posts elsewhere first.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Create at least one before writing posts.

editorToolbar.linkInvalid: Only http, https, mailto, or an internal path starting with / is accepted.
editorToolbar.imagePick: Pick an image from your computer
editorToolbar.imageAltPlaceholder: Leave empty if the image is decorative
editorToolbar.imageHostInvalid: Images must use https and come from an allowed host. Hosts outside the list break in production because next/image blocks them.
editorToolbar.imageMeasureFailed: Could not measure the image (it failed to load, or CORS blocked it). You can still insert it, but it renders in a 16:9 frame instead of its real size.
editorToolbar.linkHint: Clear the field and press Apply to remove the link. Outbound links automatically carry rel="nofollow noopener" when rendered.

upload.label: Upload an image
upload.contentMismatch: The file's content does not match its format. It may be corrupt, or just renamed.
upload.notUploaded: The server could not find the file you just uploaded. Start over.

slugs.title: Slugs
slugs.description: Whenever a published post's slug changes, the old slug is kept here so the old URL still redirects to the post. They cannot be added by hand — they only ever appear automatically.
slugs.caption: Slugs of blog posts
slugs.searchPlaceholder: Paste part of a URL, e.g. nau-pho
slugs.empty: No old URLs yet. They appear when you change the slug of a published post.
slugs.emptyFiltered: No old URL matches these filters.
slugs.panelHint: These URLs still redirect to the post. Read only here.

edit.title: Edit old URL
edit.consequence: {old} will stop working and return a 404. In its place, {next} will redirect to {title}.
edit.unknownTraffic: If this URL is still in search results or still linked to from other sites, that traffic is lost. The system does not track this — check for yourself before continuing. There is no undo.

delete.title: Delete old URL
delete.body: {url} will stop redirecting and return a 404 permanently. There is no undo.
delete.postStaysReachable: The post itself stays reachable at {url}.
